races.paceDynamic: Gone Rogue and Miss Chester will break fast and set an honest early gallop, with Toralou, Riyadh Gem, Tilani and Pearly Squirrel likely to sit just off the pace. The front two should maintain a solid tempo through the middle stages, creating a genuine test that will stretch the field. This honest pace scenario strongly favours the hold-up horses like Hello Cotai, Dark Rosa, Virtue Patience, Jet Packer, Pay Attention, Time After Time and Spirit Lead Me who can conserve energy and finish strongest. The sustained gallop will expose the prominent runners and reward those with the best finishing kicks from the back.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong honest gallop
scenarios.trigger: If Gone Rogue and Miss Chester maintain a solid early tempo and keep finding
scenarios.body: The sustained pace stretches the field and sets up a cavalry charge finish from the back markers. Hold-up horses with proven finishing speed get the perfect setup to unleash late.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Moderate even tempo
scenarios.trigger: If the front runners settle into a steady rhythm without excessive early pressure
scenarios.body: The race develops into a more tactical affair where prominent runners can conserve energy and kick clear. Those sitting handy can time their challenge perfectly in the final two furlongs.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Collapse of pace
scenarios.trigger: If both Gone Rogue and Miss Chester fade quickly leaving a tactical vacuum
scenarios.body: The pace falls apart completely creating a stop-start affair that becomes a sprint finish. Fresh horses returning from breaks or those with natural speed benefit most from the tactical nature.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front runner dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Gone Rogue gets an easy lead and controls the fractions throughout
scenarios.body: The leader gets soft sectionals early and has enough left to repel all challengers. The honest pace never materializes allowing the front runner to dictate and win going away.

races.paceDynamic: This will be a fierce gallop with Oursin, High Degree, Alcarath, Clouds Hill and Al Durry all committed to leading early, creating an unsustainable pace over 1m2f. The tempo will be red-hot through the first mile as these five fight for position, with Hand Of God and Something Splendid tracking just behind. The brutal early fractions will severely compromise the front-runners, setting up a perfect scenario for the hold-up horses to sweep through tired leaders in the final furlong. This race shape strongly favours closers and hold-up performers who can benefit from the pace collapse.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is as fierce as expected with all five front-runners going hard
scenarios.body: The pace will collapse dramatically in the final quarter-mile, allowing patient hold-up horses to pick up the pieces as the early leaders tie up. Parole d'Oro, Celeborn, Mustazeed and Al Aali are perfectly positioned to exploit this scenario with their preferred closing style.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: One Leader Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the front-runners can steal a march and avoid the early battle
scenarios.body: Al Durry or Clouds Hill could skip clear of the scrimmaging and maintain enough energy to hold off late closers. Their recent form suggests they have the class to sustain a solo effort if they get first run.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Hand Of God can secure the ideal tracking position behind the battling leaders
scenarios.body: The prominent runners will have the perfect trip, close enough to strike but far enough back to avoid the early carnage. Something Splendid's 7lb claimer could also provide the edge needed from this tactical position.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Holds Together
scenarios.trigger: If the jockeys show unusual restraint and moderate the early tempo
scenarios.body: The race could become a test of pure ability rather than tactics, favouring the highest-rated performers regardless of style. This scenario seems unlikely given the natural pace in the field.

races.paceDynamic: Sponsor and Oceti will ensure a solid early gallop, with both having shown front-running tendencies and needing to establish position early from this field of 16. The pace should be honest rather than frantic, as neither front runner appears overly aggressive, creating a rhythm that will test stamina over the final two furlongs. With multiple hold-up horses including class act Extremely Zain and several unraced newcomers likely to be positioned patiently, the race sets up perfectly for closers who can finish strongly. This race shape clearly favours hold-up horses and patient rides, as the solid pace will stretch the field and create gaps for late runners to exploit.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Class Horse Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace develops as expected with Sponsor and Oceti setting honest fractions
scenarios.body: The established gallop will perfectly suit Extremely Zain's hold-up style, allowing Fallon to deliver his strike late when the early pace takes its toll. The class difference will show as the winner pulls clear in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Newcomer Springs Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If one of the unraced Varian or Crisford runners shows immediate ability
scenarios.body: The patient positioning of the newcomers behind the solid pace will allow them to finish strongly with race fitness not yet tested. Fresh legs and untapped ability could overcome the more exposed runners.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If both Sponsor and Oceti fail to maintain their early positions or go too conservatively
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows a prominent runner to steal a march and the hold-up horses find insufficient pace to aim at. A horse that can position closer benefits from the lack of genuine tempo.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Sponsor or Oceti gets an uncontested lead and reasonable fractions
scenarios.body: The leader gets into a rhythm and has enough in reserve to hold off the late challenge, benefiting from controlled fractions. The closing horses leave their run too late on ground that may be riding slower.

races.paceDynamic: Blue Hercules will take this field along as the sole confirmed leader, setting a comfortable tempo without pressure from the front. Point Of Law, Hatteen and Siwa Oasis will track in behind in the prominent positions, while the hold-up horses Glory Road, Much and El Loco will need to rely on the pace holding up. With minimal early speed signed on beyond Blue Hercules, this sets up as a steady gallop that could become pedestrian. This race shape strongly favours prominent trackers who can position handy and have something left to kick, as the lack of genuine pace pressure will make it difficult for hold-up horses to pick up the pieces.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Wins
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays steady throughout and Blue Hercules fades as expected
scenarios.body: Point Of Law or Hatteen can track the leader and strike when the tempo lifts entering the straight. The moderate gallop allows them to conserve energy while staying in touch, then outkick the fading leader.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Unknown Quantity Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the newcomers has significant ability and can position prominently
scenarios.body: The lightly-raced horses Phantom Recon, Steamroller or Zynak benefit from the lack of early pace by getting a good position and having natural finishing kick. Their unknown quantities could be well above this level.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Blue Hercules sets a genuinely strong pace or the tempo increases mid-race
scenarios.body: Glory Road or El Loco can capitalize on a truly-run race where the early pace collapses. This requires the gallop to be more testing than the single leader suggests.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Leader Stays On
scenarios.trigger: If Blue Hercules improves dramatically and the pace stays very moderate
scenarios.body: The front-runner benefits from an uncontested lead and weak pace, staying on when others can't quicken. His fading tendency makes this unlikely but possible at this level.

races.paceDynamic: Heyzoom stands alone as the confirmed front runner with solid form figures of 3-2, giving him a clear run at uncontested fractions over this 1m2f trip. The five debutants (Brocklesby Bill, Knight Of Storms, Round The Table, Tropbien) create uncertainty but none have shown early pace in trials, while the proven runners Besieged, Echo Of Stars split between prominent tactics and the hold-up horses Electric Dreams, Salgados, Tambora sit further back. With Heyzoom likely dictating a steady tempo without pressure, this race strongly favours prominent runners who can track the leader and those with tactical speed to strike in the straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Heyzoom Controls Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Heyzoom gets an uncontested lead and maintains steady fractions
scenarios.body: The front runner dictates throughout while prominent runners like Besieged and Echo Of Stars get ideal trips tracking behind. The lack of early pace pressure allows Heyzoom to kick for home with the chasers needing to find extra acceleration late.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Debut Winner Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If one of the Gosden/Simcock/Clover debutants shows natural early pace
scenarios.body: A well-bred newcomer takes up the running or sits prominent, potentially outclassing this modest maiden field with superior ability. The Gosden runner Tropbien or Simcock's Knight Of Storms could have the class edge over exposed rivals.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes crawling slow allowing closers to wind up
scenarios.body: Tambora or Electric Dreams get the perfect scenario with a pedestrian gallop that suits their come-from-behind style. The patient tactics of Dobbs and Muscutt pay dividends as they time their runs to perfection in the final two furlongs.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If Heyzoom and the prominent runners go too fast early on this testing track
scenarios.body: The front group hits the wall in the final furlong after unsustainable fractions over 1m2f at Newbury. Late closers like Salgados benefit from the collapse while one of the hold-up horses storms home at rewarding odds.

Echo Of Stars returning from long layoff but Spencer wouldn't take the ride without expecting a big run from the consistent performer
If the early pace looks slow, Tambora and Electric Dreams could be overpriced given their come-from-behind running styles
North Beach needs to bounce back from poor last effort but course suits Balding runners and stable is in excellent form

races.paceDynamic: Three Socks On is the sole confirmed front-runner and will dictate terms unopposed from the gates, but his tendency to fade late creates tactical complications. The prominent runners (Extraterrestrial, Armstrong, Glenna, Brighton View, Tough Date) will sit within striking distance but won't pressure the leader early. This sets up a scenario where the pace could be modest through the middle sections, before the large contingent of hold-up horses (Grand Pier, Kakirra, Flash Kozo, Virtue Chastity, Berkshire Schmokin, Dijon Gone, Madjid) launch their challenges. The lack of pace pressure early strongly favours closers who can unleash a sustained finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Three Socks On maintains his recent improved form and doesn't fade as badly as usual
scenarios.body: His two recent wins suggest improved stamina and the lack of early pace pressure allows him to control fractions perfectly. The prominent runners get caught in no-man's land as the pace quickens too late for effective challenges.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heroes Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes overly sedate through the middle sections with Three Socks On unchallenged
scenarios.body: The large group of closers get the perfect setup with plenty of horse left for a sustained drive. Madjid and Kakirra, both in good recent form, can unleash their finishing kicks from ideal positions.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners positions perfectly behind Three Socks On and times their move right
scenarios.body: Armstrong or Extraterrestrial can stalk the leader closely enough to strike when he begins to weaken in the final furlong. Their tactical positioning gives them first run on the fading front-runner before the closers can organize.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Three Socks On goes too slowly early and the field bunches up approaching the home turn
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the two-furlong pole with little separation between runners. This chaotic finish could suit any horse with a turn of foot regardless of running style.

races.paceDynamic: Curran is the only confirmed front runner and will lead uncontested, allowing him to dictate a steady, sustainable gallop in the early stages. The prominent runners Percy Jones, Amancio and Perfect Scoundrel will track close behind but are unlikely to apply serious pressure given their tactical styles. With 12 of the 16 runners adopting hold-up tactics, the pace will be steady for the first mile before quickening significantly from the 3f pole as the large pack of closers make their moves. This race shape strongly favours the hold-up horses who can benefit from the solid tempo and deliver their finish from off the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays steady as expected and the large group of closers get clear runs
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader Curran will weaken in the final 2f as the fresh hold-up brigade sweeps past. Quality closers like Educator, Rose Cotton and Kimeko Glory have the class to capitalize on the perfect setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Exploitation
scenarios.trigger: If Curran gets loose on the lead and the prominent runners fail to close the gap
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows Curran to conserve energy and kick again when challenged. Percy Jones and Amancio might track him through but struggle to reel in a well-ridden leader.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Tactical Shuffle
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners decide to pressure Curran earlier than expected
scenarios.body: A faster pace develops from halfway, setting up the race for horses with tactical speed who can position handily. Perfect Scoundrel and Amancio benefit from being closer to the pace without having to lead.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Curran goes too slowly and the field bunches up turning for home
scenarios.body: A messy sprint finish develops where positioning and luck in running become crucial. The race becomes a lottery where any horse getting a clear run can win.

watchPoints.text: Curran could steal this if allowed uncontested lead as the hold-up horses leave their runs too late
Perfect Scoundrel and Amancio might press forward earlier if Curran goes too slowly, changing the pace dynamics
Educator has strong recent form and is well-positioned to capitalize if the race unfolds as expected
The large group of hold-up horses could cause traffic problems in the straight if they all move together
Rose Cotton's recent course form makes her particularly dangerous if getting a clear run from the back
